propositions: _commit_binding_store_snapshot bypasses the atomic locked commit transaction and uses raw git_adapter.add/commit, causing .bridge_state/last-pass.json to be swept into staging on every pass and advancing HEAD incorrectly on idempotent runs
The existing commit_and_push_tickets_branch seam stages all changes with git add -A, which is incompatible with selective per-file binding store snapshot staging
A new commit_tickets_branch(tracker, message=, paths=, strict=) helper must extract the locked commit phase (excluding push) to enable pathspec-scoped staging without sweeping in per-pass timestamps

_commit_binding_store_snapshot must route through the locked seam with paths restricted to the 5 allowlisted .bridge_state files and strict=True to preserve the fail-open bool+stderr+bridge_alerts contract

Per-file idempotency is preserved when pathspec-scoped git status --porcelain reports changes only in the allowlisted files, such that retiring a file commits but an unchanged pass does not advance HEAD
